summary: Other long entries repeat the same pattern (checked 0.17.0, 0.23.0, 0.30.0 against the old notes; content complete, dates right): 0.17.0 has 19 bullets, 8 Upgrading steps and nested 7-line refusal/migrate sub-lists (the per-command 'refused with canon migrate' list, the `canon migrate` step-by-step effects); condense to: layout moved (`canon migrate`), approvals only in `.canon/changes/<change>/brief.md`, `statusVersion` 3, init/skills prompts. 0.23.0 spends ~35 lines on exit-code tables for new commands (`ledger compact`, `artifacts verify`, `artifacts migrate`) and archive internals; keep the 5 Upgrading steps, the Breaking list and one line per new command. 0.30.0's first Breaking bullet is a 600-char path naming grammar (`kind=<kind>/<key components joined by _>_<digest8>.json`, escape rules) - say 'ledger files are renamed, run `canon migrate`' and keep the example path only. 0.16.0 averages 330 chars/bullet over 22 bullets (the longest in the file), and 0.14-0.22 average 200-260 chars/bullet; give each version the same pass: one user-visible change per line, no field inventories. Whole file is 870 lines (old notes 3,940), which meets the README/CHANGELOG split but not the human's ~20-line-per-version sample for the big releases.
